_doc: Stream C (Expansion 1). Quests for zone 'steamwood' on Vharlen, the Burning Isle. Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/vharlen-province.json).

old_varr.name: Old Varr
old_varr.greeting: Seventy years in the Steamwood. The jungle has tried to eat me every one of them. It has bad manners and no teeth left.

steam_wife_ninu.name: Steam-wife Ninu
steam_wife_ninu.greeting: The springs heal anything but stupidity. Sit. Soak. Do not drink it.

corra_sulvenn.name: Corra Sulvenn
corra_sulvenn.greeting: Ironpalm sap, bottled steam, a very small amount of honesty. What do you need?

angler_mistfall.name: Oru Keshvar
angler_mistfall.greeting: Fish in the hot pools come out half-cooked. Saves a fire. See the ripples, just east of where I'm standing? That's the town pool. It never fishes out.

carter_mistfall.name: Orsk Yorrvenn
carter_mistfall.greeting: Walking is free. Riding is nearly free, and you arrive with your feet unboiled.

quests.name: Prowler Season
quests.offer: The prowlers have had cubs, and now the parents have opinions about everyone who walks past. Thin them out before they have opinions about Mistfall.

steps.text: Kill 6 steamwood prowlers in the deep jungle

quests.done: The leaves are moving again. That is how you know it is safe. Or that something worse is coming. Mostly safe.

quests.name: Spit in the Springs
quests.offer: The sulphur toads sit in my healing springs and spit in them. I have patients who come out yellower than they went in.

steps.text: Kill 7 sulphur toads at the hot pools

quests.done: Clean water, nearly. Go and soak in it. You smell like a toad.

quests.name: Steam in a Jar
quests.offer: A vent wisp, popped at the right moment, leaves a puff of steam you can cork. A jar of it lights a lamp for a week. It smells like eggs. It sells like bread.

steps.text: Catch 5 jars of wisp-steam from vent wisps

quests.done: Five jars! I will sell four and keep one for the outhouse.

quests.name: Mother of Moss
quests.offer: There is a thing in the stream beds that grows moss on its back and lets the moss do the thinking. Mother of Moss, we call her. She has started taking my herb-pickers.

steps.where: the mossy stream beds of the Steamwood

quests.done: Bring me a scrap of that moss next time. Waste not.

quests.name: The Hissing Grotto
quests.offer: The grotto under the big geyser has hissed since before I was born. This month it started hissing words. Take some friends and go and tell it to stop.

steps.text: Go down into the Hissing Grotto
steps.where: The Hissing Grotto, the dungeon door in the Steamwood

steps.text: Defeat whatever is talking at the bottom of the grotto
steps.where: the bottom of The Hissing Grotto

quests.done: It has gone back to plain hissing. Much better. Words from the ground are never good news. Yellowpan has its own troubles, if you are walking that way.

quests.name: The Canopy Widow
quests.offer: Something up in the ironpalm canopy drops on my sap-tappers and hauls them up by the ankle. We call her the Canopy Widow. I would like my tappers to stay on the ground.

steps.text: Kill 5 scoria crawlers under the fallen ironpalms

steps.where: the high canopy of the Steamwood

quests.done: My tappers send their thanks, from ground level. The wreckers on Glasswind Strand are lighting false fires again, by the way. Someone ought to look.
